changelog: Added Live Chat: Chat with friends in real time while watching together.
Unread badges: Easily see when you have new messages when chat is closed.
Smart Host Transfer: Automatically assigns a new host if the original host leaves.
Fresh new design for Watch Party buttons, host badges, and Space cards.

features.title: What's New
items: Live Chat: Chat in real time with your friends during Watch Parties.
Message Alerts: Get passive badges for unread messages when the chat panel is closed.
Automatic Host Transfer: If the host leaves, another member is automatically assigned as the new host.
Mobile Friendly: Access chat easily on mobile with an overlay button matched to player controls.

features.title: Better Experience
items: Redesigned Watch Party buttons and host badges for a cleaner look.
Upgraded Space cards with a live party indicator and smooth floating animations.
Easier chat experience with automatic scrolling and auto-focus when opened.

features.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed background sync issues to ensure accurate playback for guests.
